name: Gaussian-copula bilateral pairing with fixed marginal grids
correlation_scope: The same assumed latent correlation applies separately within each cell.
pairing_algorithm: For a cell of size m, assign standard-normal quantile scores Phi_inverse((i+0.5)/m) to ascending right-hand positions. Draw m independent standard-normal errors and form left latent scores as rho*z_right + sqrt(1-rho^2)*error. Assign ascending supplied left-hand values to ascending left latent scores. Return the resulting local left indices in ascending right-hand order.
finite_grid_interpretation: A randomized, stratified approximation to a Gaussian copula; finite-cell empirical correlations need not equal their population limits.
marginals: Preserve every supplied marginal value exactly; do not regenerate, rescale, truncate, or add trial-level noise.
measurement_unit: kg; each hand value is the person's mean of three attempts
dependence_status: Assumed, not identified or estimated from the supplied study.
population_scope: An equally weighted synthetic mixture of the four supplied sex/age cells, anchored to the source's symptom/arthritis-excluded community sample; not a representative sample of all adults aged 50–69.
